name: Kisaragi Mitama
source:
A teacher at the protagonist's school with a license in healthcare...in other words, she's the school nurse.

She is one of the few women at the all-boys' school, and her calm and gentle personality makes her very popular. This makes her the object of everyone's admiration on the surface, but in her private life, she is a total failure. 

She is a good-for-nothing older sister lacking in feminine energy, but she greatly excels in making others spoil her.

Even today, she spends her time lazily relying on her beloved Na-kun (her nickname for the protagonist).

[translated from [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/comet/koreuba/c01.html]official website[/url]]
